title: Copper matrix composite coatings produced by cold spraying process for electrical applications

experimentalProperties.Additional_Manufacturing_Processes_Descr: surfaces of the coatings were grinded with 1000 grit SiC paper and polished with diamond slurry.

preSprayedProperties.Powder_Blend_Ratio: 5 vol.% Al2Cu (53 wt% Cu and 47 wt.% Al), Bal. Cu
preSprayedProperties.Powder_Particle_Size_Other: Pure Al had an mean size of 12 μm
preSprayedProperties.Powder_Heat_Treatment_Description: The 53 wt% Cu and 47 wt.% Al were compacted and held at 550°C for 6h. Compacts were then broken into pieces, ball milled and sieved through 325 mesh sieve to collect irregular Al2Cu powders smaller than 44 μm.

experimentalProperties.Additional_Manufacturing_Processes_Descr: surfaces of the coatings were grinded with 1000 grit SiC paper and polished withdiamond slurry.

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: 1.3 vol.% Al2Cu in deposit. Porosities were elliptical.
